findings.design: A second field labeled 'Confirm password' (type password, masked value) with a success-state suffix icon (green circle + checkmark) indicating the confirmation matches the new password.
findings.app: absent — the form only renders a single 'New password' input; there is no confirmation field at all.
findings.evidence: design: openspec/design/auth-components.jsx:309-311 (NewPasswordScreen → Field label='Confirm password' suffix=checkmark svg) vs app: apps/web/app/pages/reset-password.vue:49-96 (only one password input, no second field)

findings.design: Confirm-password field's checkmark suffix implies live client-side validation that the two password entries match before allowing submission.
findings.app: No mismatch/typo protection exists — handleSubmit only checks password.value.length < 8; a user who mistypes their new password has no way to catch it before submit.
findings.evidence: design: openspec/design/auth-components.jsx:309-311 vs app: apps/web/app/pages/reset-password.vue:140-142 (handleSubmit length check only, no confirm value to compare against)

findings.design: PasswordStrength component labels the field simply 'Password'.
